name: grounded_document_qa
goal: Answer a policy question from enterprise documents with citations and abstain when evidence is insufficient.

name: multimodal_chart_qa
goal: Use text plus a chart/page image and verify cross-modal consistency.

name: bounded_reflection
goal: When evidence is insufficient, issue one focused retrieve-more attempt and stop within the configured retry budget.

name: safe_mcp_tool_use
goal: Select a read-only MCP tool while rejecting write/execute tools under default policy.

name: taskspec_to_canvas
goal: Compile a restricted TaskSpec into RAGFlow Canvas-shaped DSL without allowing arbitrary tool or code injection.

name: router_promotion_gate
goal: Train/evaluate an advisory router and prevent deployment unless protected benchmark gates pass.
success_criteria: protected test never used for training
